questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy under review, the Climate Emergency Plan, clearly identifies climate action as its core purpose. The policy aims to reduce carbon emissions and adapt to the immediate impacts of climate change within the local context. It outlines a 10-year plan with specific actions to be monitored and implemented, such as measuring CO2 emissions annually and monitoring progress against emissions reduction targets. The policy also sets a goal of achieving zero carbon by 2030 and estimates a 49% reduction in emissions through the actions in the Climate Emergency Plan. The policy also includes a Council Action Plan detailing how the council can take direct actions to reduce their carbon impact and adapt to the immediate impacts of climate change. Therefore, it is evident that the core purpose of this policy is climate action.
